messages:
Alex K.: heads-up — run into multiple customers asking for richer per-request telemetry in responses (token counts + trace ids) so they can reconcile cost and debug. want to align on naming + opt-in behavior.
Maria G.: +1. propose minimal server response fields: trace_id, request_id, model, client_id, and token usage (input/output/total). also consider a cost_estimate field returned in microunits. thoughts?
Jordan P.: naming debate: our SDKs historically use camelCase, internal pipelines use snake_case. i'd prefer server-side snake_case for readability and map to SDK camelCase.
Rohan S.: flag: we should avoid inflating response sizes by default. strongly suggest token fields be behind an opt-in query param or header (e.g. ?include_token_metadata=true or x-rwdw-token-metadata: true). default = off.
Maria G.: launch criteria proposal: (1) server-side stable field names + schema doc, (2) SDK surface mapping implemented in major SDKs, (3) opt-in flag and feature flag for rollout, (4) perf/regression tests proving <1% p99 latency/size impact, (5) migration docs and examples.
Alex K.: customer asks from CS: embeddings pipelines want token counts for batch billing; rerank/chat teams want trace ids threaded through tool calls. we need to scope: per-request totals for GA, per-tool breakdown as experimental for v2.
Jordan P.: agreed. for trace ids — keep it consistent with observability: use "trace_id" (64-bit hex) and echo it as a top-level response field + response header x-rw-trace-id. don't invent new names.
Rohan S.: also callout: tool/function calling will require attribution; propose we return optional "token_usage_by_segment" schema but mark it experimental. default only returns top-level "token_usage".
Maria G.: quick schema example to include in spec PR:
```json
{
  "trace_id": "0x12ab34cd...",
  "request_id": "rq_01F...",
  "model": "redwood-open-7b",
  "token_usage": {
    "input_tokens": 12,
    "output_tokens": 34,
    "total_tokens": 46
  },
  "cost_units": "microunits"
}
```
Jordan P.: note: in SDKs we'll map server snake_case -> camelCase so user sees tokenUsage.inputTokens etc. also add helpers to compute cost from cost_units.
Alex K.: action items: @Jordan P. update SDK mapping and add samples; @Maria G. open spec PR with rollout plan + docs + examples; @Rohan S. run perf delta tests and confirm opt-in header behavior. can we aim EOW for initial PR?
Jordan P.: I can have the SDK PR by Thurs. will make mapping reversible and add tests.
Maria G.: i'll draft the server spec PR today and include canary rollout steps + telemetry for adoption. will also document how this interacts with Dedicated/Private deployments and privacy controls.
Rohan S.: will run perf tests against typical chat and embedding loads. will flag if size increase > 2% p99. also propose a feature flag to gate the header for Private deployments.
Alex K.: SG. if there are no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll mark the schema as our agreed minimal v1 and create product tickets for v2 items (per-tool breakdown, per-segment cost attribution).
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: feature-flag infra updated for opt-in token metadata (canary). :rocket:
Maria G.: thanks all — i'll ping when PR is up and add a short sample migration note for customers.
